fixes.stacked-nouns: Keep at most two nouns together. Unpack the rest with a preposition or a relative clause, if the result reads naturally; leave an established term as it is.
fixes.long-dependency: Put the subject next to its verb. Move long modifiers after the verb or into a second sentence.
fixes.reduced-object-relative: Keep the 'that'. If the clause is long, make it a sentence of its own.
fixes.hyphen-compound: Replace the hyphenated chain with a phrase that says how its words relate.
